description.value: The Original John's of Bleecker Street is a historic pizzeria on Bleecker Street in the Greenwich Village neighborhood. The pizzeria serves coal fired brick oven pizza prepared in the style of a tomato pie. It sells whole pies only, so come hungry or bring a friend. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “Pizza was great, staff was friendly and welcoming.”. Representative watch-outs: “About 40-45 mins of waiting line, but it was worth it.”. Tripadvisor shows 4.4 of 5 bubbles (1,975 reviews) for the 278 Bleecker St pizzeria.
